notes: Omen has both now, so all three portals do (CEO: "now do omen"). Its cards take the same frosted glass cut from the real wallpaper, and it fades out, moves and fades back in when a new position is clicked.

Omen is the one theme that HAD read the blur setting all along and set `backdrop-filter` from it - and it had never blurred a pixel, for the same reason as the others: a portal is a transparent window with nothing behind its page to…

The glass is its own element here rather than a pseudo: .gauge's ::before is the gradient border ring and its ::after the angled corner strokes, and a background layer cannot be faded. It carries the card's whole background stack - image…

The move fade is now written onto the page instead of declared in a stylesheet, because the three portals do not share one: Mirage and Charm carry the shared entrance classes and Omen has an entrance of its own. The page is handed back…
